UNDERSTANDING EXTENSIVE READING
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding extensive reading means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Extensive Reading.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Extensive Reading. Get clear on extensive reading before moving on. How would you explain extensive reading to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Identify appropriate language structures in a reading text,. Clue from the topic: Read different forms of greetings. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Read different forms of greetings.
• Listen to audios and read along.
• Listen/ read to texts of people.
• Peers and read this in plenary.
• Listen and read along to audio.
• Citizenship: learner develops awareness of the role of greetings and knowing others in maintaining social cohesion.

----

Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for GERMAN.[DIAGRAM]
